findings.detail: A07 reports pct_sum=0.0%, but the current-period schedule total discloses Total Investments at 198.44% of net assets.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check: the raw SOI includes a % of Net Assets column and the current-period Total Investments row shows 198.44% of net assets, while the flagged artifact reports pct_sum=0.0%. The source therefore contradicts the extracted aggregate percentage, indicating the percentage column/total was not captured into the A07 metric.
